The package has 413 tracked `.lean` files: 412 modules plus the Lake build file `spec/proofs/lakefile.lean`, which is not a module.

## Module-count convention

A **module** is a tracked `.lean` file under `spec/proofs`, excluding `lakefile.lean` and files under `.lake/` or `__pycache__/`. Every other `.lean` file counts, including tests, probes, and experimental modules outside the default build target.

A module name is its path relative to `spec/proofs`, with `.lean` removed and `/` replaced by `.` — for example `spec/proofs/BitcoinProofs/AF/PDW10/PDW10Guards.lean` is `BitcoinProofs.AF.PDW10.PDW10Guards`. The root module `BitcoinProofs` is `spec/proofs/BitcoinProofs.lean`.

The **default closure** is the root module plus every module reachable through `import` lines whose imported name exists in this module set. Imports of `Bitcoin.*`, `Mathlib`, `Batteries`, and other external packages are ignored for local closure membership.

`docs/PROOF-BUILD.md` records a historical build census of 381 outside-closure `.lean` files, one more than the 380 outside-closure modules in that original snapshot. Its 381 total came from 410 tracked `.lean` files minus the then-29-module closure, so it includes the non-module `lakefile.lean`; it is a build record and is not regenerated by this script.
